explication: ClaudeBar is a macOS menu-bar dashboard for AI coding quotas. Users enable providers; provider definitions collect usage, which the app presents with reset countdowns and alerts. The repository also supports daily usage, multi-account logins, extensions, themes, notch and Touch Bar displays, session hooks, and Notify! device publishing. The graph uses documented capabilities and indexed source references; several UI-to-domain runtime calls are not shown in the excerpts, so those links are marked unverified rather than asserted as inspected.
